passages.note: Senate floor final passage of the Senate-amended text, 29-8 (over 10% No); Allen voted Aye during his current Senate term.

passages.provision_quote: shall not enact or enforce any policy, rule, or administrative regulation that would require an employee or a contractor to disclose any information related to a pupil’s sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression to any other person without the pupil’s consent, unless otherwise required by state or federal law.
passages.note: Operative Section 220.5 forbids local policies that require disclosure, which is the rung's own question of who decides; it does not require staff to withhold (rung 1) and bars disclosure mandates (rungs 3-5).

rows.reasoning: Allen voted Aye on Senate final passage of AB 1955 (2023-2024), a single-subject pupil-rights bill whose operative Section 220.5 says schools "shall not enact or enforce any policy, rule, or administrative regulation that would require an employee or a contractor to disclose" a pupil's gender identity without consent. That matches "Forbid rules that require schools to tell parents." It does not reach "Require staff to keep a student's gender identity from parents unless the student consents", because Section 220.3 only says staff shall not be required to disclose.
